<finding task="2"><quote>| `pythons` | list of strings | no | The interpreters, one run each, in order. Default `['3.13']`. |</quote><plan>constants `REPO: Path` (the repo root), `REGISTRY = 'build/suites.toml'`, `DEFAULT_PYTHONS = ('3.12',)`, `TEST_FILE_PATTERNS`;</plan><fix>Set `DEFAULT_PYTHONS = ('3.13',)` in the Interfaces block and in the module. In every Task 2 and Task 4 test, change each expected `3.12` to `3.13`. That covers `run.label == 'alpha (3.12)'`, the argv and shell-form tuples, the `--list` expected lines, the `FakeRuns` labels, and `'ghost (3.12): cannot start'`. With the 3.12 default, no default shell form can equal the current `CLAUDE.md` command, because those commands use `--python 3.13` (see Task 1, Step 4). The Task 5 audit would then fail check 1 for 16 of the 18 suites.</fix></finding>
<finding task="5"><quote>| `pythons` | list of strings | no | The interpreters, one run each, in order. Default `['3.13']`. |</quote><plan>#   pythons  optional: one run per interpreter, in order (default ['3.12'])</plan><fix>Change the registry header comment to `(default ['3.13'])`, so that it matches R2.2 and the corrected `DEFAULT_PYTHONS`.</fix></finding>
<finding task="7"><quote>R3.2 **One run** is one interpreter of one suite. Its command is
`uv run --python <python> --with <dep> … python -m pytest -q [<args>]`, run with the suite's `dir` as its
working directory. Its shell form is `cd <dir> && <command>`, with shell quoting where a word needs it. With
default options, the shell form equals the suite's current `CLAUDE.md` command, character for character.</quote><plan>In a worktree without `build/.scratch/`, it is instead `suite runs failed: build (3.12)` on stderr, with exit 1, matching Step 2.</plan><fix>Change the expected line to `suite runs failed: build (3.13)`. The Planning record's prototype claim ("passed every run except `build (3.12)`") shows the same error: the prototype ran the suites under 3.12 rather than under the `CLAUDE.md` commands' 3.13. Correct that claim too, and re-run the replay before you claim any byte-identical result.</fix></finding>
<finding task="7"><quote>Drop "There is no root test runner" and the sentence that comments name the skip-unlocking deps.</quote><plan>`build/suites.toml` registers each suite (its directory, its `--with` deps, the extras that unlock its skips, and its notes), and `build/run_suites.py` runs them, printing a suite's notes before its output; pytest's summary line gives the counts.</plan><fix>The plan keeps the second half of the dropped sentence ("pytest's summary line gives the counts"). Either drop that clause as R5.1 says, or record a deviation that explains why the clause stays.</fix></finding>
